data.title: Fusion Antibodies boosts margins and cash as OptiMAL launch and patents strengthen growth platform
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Fusion Antibodies Plc ( (GB:FAB) ).

Fusion Antibodies reported audited revenues of £2.1 million for the year to 31 March 2026, with underlying service revenue of £1.86 million and second-half revenue up 21% versus the first half. The company’s gross margin rose sharply to 58.3%, while the operating loss narrowed to £1.13 million and cash balances increased to £1.04 million, aided by grant income and a £1.4 million fundraise.

Operationally, Fusion commercially launched its OptiMAL platform after validation work with the U.S. National Cancer Institute and progressed patent protection for its Opti library in Japan, Canada and Australia. Management highlighted growing engagement from larger organisations, strategic diversification into segments such as veterinary markets and advancement of the DR5 therapeutic antibody programme, positioning the company to convert scientific progress into more sustainable commercial growth despite challenging market conditions.
